creator: Alexander Terp
description: Restoring tabs after a daemon restart runs on its own thread and checks each recorded directory. A directory on a hung mount blocks that thread as long as the mount does. The state file stays untouched, which is safe, but no later tab comes back until the mount answers. Consider a per-directory timeout that falls back to home, as a gone directory already does.
title: Daemon restore waits forever on a hung directory
